title: @topo/diagram-core: public surface
summary: The rendering module's exposed functions, shared input/output interfaces, and declared renderer dependencies. Arrows mean exports, contract references, or declared package dependencies—not private rendering steps. This private workspace API is bundled into @jdylanmc/topo-code; it is not a separately published stable SDK. Unlabelled spokes from the package box to API/utility boxes mean root exports; labelled edges distinguish other references.

anchors.pattern: export function renderStory(story: ResolvedStoryDocument): StoryArtifact | Promise<StoryArtifact> {

sections.title: @jdylanmc/topo-archify
sections.body: Declared peer: @jdylanmc/topo-archify@0.1.0. This package supplies the pinned native Archify runtime. Consumers meet the peer requirement; it is not a child module re-exported by diagram-core.

sections.title: Single-story API
sections.body:
renderStory(story: ResolvedStoryDocument) -> StoryArtifact | Promise<StoryArtifact>.

Input is already resolved source evidence, not raw repository scanning or an unvalidated JSON draft. The return can be synchronous or asynchronous, so callers can await it uniformly. The story's renderer selection controls the backend; this view deliberately does not expand private layout or rendering algorithms.

sections.title: @topo/story
sections.body:
Referenced interfaces:

ResolvedStoryDocument: authored document, document path, repository root, source revision/dirty state, and resolved anchors.

StoryArtifact: HTML kind/media type, contents, optional backend assets, and renderer identity/provenance (including original/adapted output hashes when supplied).

These interfaces belong to @topo/story; diagram-core consumes/returns them. The legacy RenderInput / Artifact declarations in types.ts are not re-exported by diagram-core's package-root index.

sections.title: Architecture batch API
sections.body:
renderArchitectureStories(stories, options?) -> StoryArtifact[]
renderArchitectureStoryBatch(stories, options?) -> Generator<StoryArtifact>

Input: readonly ResolvedStoryDocument[]. The optional sourceEvidence mode is native or wrapper. These entry points accept Architecture stories; they are not general-purpose batching APIs for every diagram family.

sections.title: @topo/diagram-core
sections.body:
The root exports renderStory, renderArchitectureStories, renderArchitectureStoryBatch, verifyArchifyIntegrity, the ArchifyIntegrity type, architectureComponentWidth, and CORE_THEME_SCRIPT.

It references @topo/story for contracts, @jdylanmc/topo-archify as its native peer, and @viz-js/viz as a dependency. No bin entry is declared. Private helpers such as specification builders, renderGraphviz and viewer adaptation routines are intentionally not presented as public APIs.

sections.title: Integrity API
sections.body:
verifyArchifyIntegrity() -> ArchifyIntegrity.

The root also re-exports the ArchifyIntegrity type, an alias of the renderer package's RuntimeIntegrity contract. This reports verified runtime identity/inventory; it does not certify the correctness of an authored architecture explanation.

sections.title: @topo/cli
sections.body:
The CLI manifest declares @topo/diagram-core as a runtime workspace dependency. This is the consumer boundary you drilled through—not an assertion that every CLI function directly calls a renderer.

Click to return to the CLI's exposed surface.

sections.title: Exported utilities
sections.body:
architectureComponentWidth(title, sublabel?, finalTypography?) -> number.
CORE_THEME_SCRIPT -> string.

These are current root exports supporting integration and presentation. They are exposed helpers, not separate renderer backends or an invitation to depend on private implementation functions.

sections.title: @viz-js/viz
sections.body: Declared dependency: @viz-js/viz@3.30.0. It supplies Graphviz for explicitly selected technical workflows. It is not a silent fallback when native Archify rendering fails, and its artifacts have separate provenance.
